welcome.title: Welcome To Asked
welcome.body: Find the questions AI search will ask about your keyword, with the evidence behind each one, before you start writing.

steps.title: Start With A Keyword
steps.body: Use a specific B2B topic, like CRM software. Broad single words return thinner results.

steps.title: Every Question Shows Its Proof
steps.body: Each question carries a label, so you can see which ones buyers type and which ones AI search is predicted to ask.

steps.title: See How It Works
steps.body: The method and the Citable Passage Standard are published in full, so you can check every rule yourself.

results.trigger: First time a visitor sees a set of results

steps.title: Read The Label First
steps.body: Confirmed questions have both real demand and predicted fan-out behind them. Build your piece around these.

steps.title: Match The Answer Shape
steps.body: Each question shows the format its answer should take, from a one-line definition to a side-by-side comparison.

steps.title: Shape Your Brief
steps.body: Untick anything that doesn't fit, or edit a question's wording. Only included questions go into the brief.

steps.title: Build And Export
steps.body: Turn your selection into a brief you can paste into Google Docs or download as Markdown.

steps.title: Choose How It Predicts
steps.body: The built-in engine needs no key. Add a free Gemini key in settings for sharper fan-out predictions.
